title: Dynamics Models for Offline Hyperparameter Selection in Real-World RL
abstract: arXiv:2608.11349v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A key obstacle to deploying reinforcement learning in real-world systems is hyperparameter selection, particularly when simulators are unavailable and online experimentation is costly. Prior work has proposed calibration models trained on offline data to approximate environment dynamics and enable offline hyperparameter selection, but these methods have so far been evaluated only in simple simulated settings. In this paper, we present the first application of calibration models in a real-world industrial setting: a municipal water treatment plant. We evaluate several calibration model approaches, including a k-nearest neighbors model with a Laplacian distance metric, on high-dimensional, non-stationary sensor data for nexting prediction tasks. Our results show that these models can generate realistic long-horizon rollouts and recover meaningful hyperparameter sensitivity trends. We further examine how calibration models scale to year-l

translated_title: 现实世界强化学习中离线超参数选择的动力学模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11349v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在现实系统中部署强化学习的一个关键障碍是超参数选择，尤其是在没有模拟器且在线实验成本高昂的情况下。先前的工作提出了基于离线数据训练的校准模型来近似环境动力学，从而实现离线超参数选择，但这些方法迄今为止仅在简单的模拟环境中进行了评估。在本文中，我们首次将校准模型应用于现实工业场景：一个市政水处理厂。我们评估了几种校准模型方法，包括使用拉普拉斯距离度量的k近邻模型，用于高维、非平稳传感器数据的预测任务。我们的结果表明，这些模型能够生成逼真的长时程展开，并恢复有意义的超参数敏感性趋势。我们进一步考察了校准模型如何扩展到年度规模的数据。
tldr: 本文首次在市政水处理厂这一现实工业场景中应用校准模型进行离线超参数选择，验证了其在处理高维非平稳数据时能生成真实长时程预测并识别超参数敏感性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first real-world industrial application of calibration models for offline hyperparameter selection at a municipal water treatment plant, demonstrating their ability to generate realistic long-horizon rollouts and recover hyperparameter sensitivity trends on high-dimensional non-stationary data.
